recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lakshmi**, a 16-year-old girl from Uttar Pradesh, wrote a song expressing her desire to continue her education and resist early marriage. Her father initially dismissed the message but was persuaded by **anganwadi workers** and **village pradhan**.  The village now features painted messages advocating for change in response to Lakshmi's powerful lyrics.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Medical Education Minister demands court-monitored probe into NEET paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka Medical Education Minister Sharan Prakash Patil** criticized the ongoing investigation into the NEET question paper leak, calling for a court-monitored probe. He expressed concerns that the **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)**'s current investigation lacked transparency and confidence, suggesting powerful individuals were involved in orchestrating the scandal to manipulate MBBS seat sales.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Youth Congress protests in Delhi, chief Uday Bhanu Chib detained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian Youth Congress (IYC)** staged a protest in New Delhi demanding the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** over alleged NEET-UG question paper leaks.  Protesters, including IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib, were detained by police as they marched towards **Pradhan's** residence. The examination was cancelled on May 3rd and a re-test is scheduled for June 21st. The IYC accused the BJP-led government of creating a corrupt system that favors wealthy students while disadvantaging those from poor backgrounds.

recent_articles.title: NSUI holds protest outside Education Minister’s residence over NEET paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Members of the National Students’ Union of India (NSUI)** protested outside **Dharmendra Pradhan's** residence in Delhi, demanding his resignation following allegations of a paper leak in the NEET-UG 2026 examination. The protesters accused the Education Minister of failing to protect students and demanded a Supreme Court-monitored investigation into the incident, along with action against those involved. **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** cancelled the exam and announced it would be retaken at a later date.

recent_articles.title: Education Budget will grow every year, says Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** announced that the **Telangana government** will prioritize education, aiming for a 15% allocation in future budgets, gradually increasing from the current 7.6%.  He highlighted the implementation of several initiatives since December 2023, including teacher recruitment, DSC notifications, and global exchange programs. The "Exclusive Education Week" celebrations aim to showcase progress and improve learning facilities across the state. **Mr. Reddy** emphasized that education is an investment in the future and stressed the importance of teachers in building a better society.

recent_articles.title: Why a ministerial vacancy nearly delayed Class 12 Board exam results in T.N. - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The School Education Department of Tamil Nadu** postponed the release date for Class 12 State Board exam results due to a lack of a Minister to authorize the announcement. This decision caused significant disappointment among students, teachers, and parents as it disrupted their preparation plans.  After facing backlash from various stakeholders, including child rights groups and educationists, the department reversed its decision and released the results on May 8th, as scheduled. Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar urged the department to release the scores without delay.

recent_articles.title: NHA recognises innovators for developing AI systems for healthcare claims processing and fraud detection - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Health Authority (NHA)** concluded the Auto-Adjudication Hackathon Showcase 2026 at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, recognizing winning teams for AI-driven solutions to improve healthcare claims processing under the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY).**  The hackathon, organized by **IndiaAI Mission** and IISc Bengaluru, saw over 3,500 registrations and more than 600 participants. Teams developed AI systems for clinical document classification, radiological image analysis, and forgery detection, with **Team Nirnaya** winning the top prize in the "Clinical Document Classification and Compliance to Standard Treatment Guidelines" category.  Winning teams received cash prizes ranging from ₹2 lakh to ₹5 lakh, and their solutions could be considered for future deployment within the AB PM-JAY ecosystem.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, newly sworn in as the Chief Minister of West Bengal, inducted five new ministers into his cabinet on Saturday. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, J. P. Nadda, and Dharmendra Pradhan**, among other BJP leaders.  **Dilip Ghosh**, a senior BJP leader who secured victory in the Kharagpur seat, **Agnimitra Paul**, a fashion designer-turned-legislator who won Asansol Dakshin, **Ashok Kirtania**, a BJP stalwart who gained victory in Bangaon Uttar, and **Kshudiram Tudu**, a former school teacher from Ranibandh (ST) constituency, were among the newly appointed ministers.  **Nisith Pramanik**, a key face of BJP from North Bengal, was also inducted into the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: NHA, IndiaAI Mission and IISc showcase human-centric AI solutions to transform health claims under AB PM-JAY - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **National Health Authority (NHA)** and its partners, **IndiaAI Mission** and the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc)**, hosted an auto-adjudication hackathon showcasing AI solutions for healthcare claims management under the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)**.  Teams presented AI systems capable of analyzing medical documents, interpreting radiological images, detecting document forgery, and streamlining claim processing. The event highlighted the use of AI/ML to improve the speed, accuracy, transparency, and efficiency of claims adjudication while reducing fraud and manual intervention.
